UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private user account profile isolated per authenticated Google user.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: User display name from Google profile.

photoURL.description: Optional avatar URL from Google account.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last profile sync.

grantedAt.description: Timestamp when admin privilege was granted.

VideoProject.title: VideoProject
VideoProject.description: An AI video production request submitted by a client for the studio creator.

clientId.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID of the requesting client.

clientName.description: Display name of the requesting client.

clientPhotoURL.description: Optional avatar URL of the requesting client.

title.description: Short descriptive title of the AI video project.

videoType.description: Category of the requested AI video.

visualStyle.description: Visual direction, lighting, lens, and aesthetic notes.

brief.description: Detailed creative brief, storyline, scenes, and voiceover notes.

referenceUrl.description: Optional external reference URL for inspiration or brand assets.

previewUrl.description: Preview or final delivery video link published by the creator.

previewNote.description: Creator delivery notes accompanying the latest video cut.

version.description: Current cut version number (0 before first cut, 1..99 thereafter).

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when the request was submitted.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest project update.

EditRequest.title: EditRequest
EditRequest.description: A timecoded revision or edit request attached to a specific video project.

projectId.description: Immutable ID of the parent VideoProject.

clientId.description: Immutable client UID denormalized from parent project for secure list queries.

authorId.description: Immutable UID of the user who filed the edit request.

authorName.description: Display name of the edit request author.

timecode.description: Optional video timestamp or range (e.g., 00:14 or 00:08-00:15).

status.description: Lifecycle state of the edit request.

resolutionNote.description: Optional creator explanation of how the edit was applied.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when edit request was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest edit request update.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Direct real-time text or voice chat message between client and studio creator inside a video project.

projectId.description: Immutable ID of the parent VideoProject.

clientId.description: Immutable client UID denormalized from parent project for secure list queries.

senderId.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID of the message sender.

senderName.description: Display name of the message sender.

senderPhotoURL.description: Optional avatar URL of the message sender.

senderRole.description: Role label verified against creator/admin status.

messageType.description: Whether the message is a text message or a recorded voice note.

text.description: Message body or optional caption for a voice note.

audioData.description: Compressed audio data URL (data:audio/...) for voice notes, empty for text messages.

audioDuration.description: Duration in seconds (0..65) for voice notes.

timecodeRef.description: Optional timecode reference attached to the message.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when message was sent.

DirectThread.title: DirectThread
DirectThread.description: Private 1-on-1 direct conversation header between a signed-in user and the studio creator.

clientId.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID of the client (matches document ID).

clientPhotoURL.description: Optional avatar URL of the client.

lastMessagePreview.description: Short preview of the latest text or voice message.

lastMessageType.description: Type of the most recent message in the thread.

lastSenderRole.description: Role of whoever sent the most recent message.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when the thread was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest message in the thread.

DirectMessage.title: DirectMessage
DirectMessage.description: Private 1-on-1 text or voice message between a signed-in user and the studio creator.

clientId.description: Immutable client UID matching the parent DirectThread ID.

senderId.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID of the message sender.

senderName.description: Display name of the message sender.

senderPhotoURL.description: Optional avatar URL of the message sender.

senderRole.description: Verified role label of the sender.

messageType.description: Whether the message is text or a voice note.

text.description: Message body or optional caption for a voice note.

audioData.description: Compressed audio data URL (data:audio/...) for voice notes, empty for text messages.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when the message was sent.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user account documents containing email PII, accessible only to the owning user or studio admin.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Read-only admin allowlist documents managed out-of-band.

/projects/{projectId}.description: AI video production requests owned by a client and managed by the studio creator.

/projects/{projectId}/editRequests/{edit.description: Timecoded edit revision requests scoped to a parent video project.

/projects/{projectId}/messages/{messageI.description: Real-time text and voice chat messages scoped to a parent video project.

/directThreads/{clientId}.description: Private 1-on-1 direct chat thread between a signed-in client and the studio creator.

/directThreads/{clientId}/messages/{mess.description: Real-time text and voice messages inside a client's private 1-on-1 direct chat with the studio creator.
